_doc: Rivet's Stud Driver (Project Redmond R3, gadgets/R3_OPERATORS.md §2; Ulo's design: his hard breaches in a circle, a vertical line and an X, each a hole a body gets through once it's set off). His ability, a compact launcher in slot 2 (Z). Fire lays a salvo of explosive studs on the breakable surface the view meets (soft or reinforced: a wall, a floor, a hatch) out to `use.reachM`, the next `use.cycleS` later; the reload key picks which while it's out (`driver.lays`: the Ring, the Spine, the Cross, data/gadgets/stud_*.json). On a wall a salvo goes where the view meets it across the wall, at the height that puts its hole's bottom its `salvo.ledgeM` over the floor (gadgets/studs.ts salvoSpot). Up to `maxOut` wait at once; with one waiting the ability key gives the detonator, which sets off every one of them together (each cuts its own shape). Mechanical studs and a wireless detonator: a Damper in reach of a salvo (or an EMP on him) stops its set-off. Our own design and numbers.
name: Stud Driver
